questions.question: On this day in 1589, which Scottish monarch married Princess Anne of Denmark?
questions.explanation: James VI of Scotland, who later ascended to the English throne as James I, married Anne of Denmark on 23 November 1589.
questions.context:
On this day in 1589: Marriage of king James VI of Scotland and Anne of Denmark.
James VI and I (King of Scotland from 1567 to 1625, King of England and Ireland from 1603): James VI and I was King of Scotland as James VI from 24 July 1567, and King of England and Ireland as James I from the union of the Scottish and English crowns on 24 March 1603, until his death in 1625.

questions.question: Which American actor rose to international fame by starring as boxer Rocky Balboa in the long-running Rocky film series?
questions.explanation: Sylvester Stallone achieved stardom by creating and starring in the Rocky franchise as title character Rocky Balboa.
questions.context: Sylvester Stallone (American actor and filmmaker (born 1946)): Sylvester Gardenzio Stallone is an American actor and filmmaker. He rose to fame as an action star for his memorable portrayals of boxer Rocky Balboa in the Rocky franchise (1976–present) and of soldier John Rambo in the Rambo franchise (1982–2019). Stallone usually portrayed underdog characters who conquer seemingly impossible challenges through perseverance and determination in his films, and his physically expressive and emotionally charged style of acting redefined the action hero.

questions.question: Which English pop group, famous for hits in the late 1990s and 2000s, was originally launched by music manager Simon Fuller in 1998?
questions.explanation: S Club (originally known as S Club 7) was created by Simon Fuller in 1998 with seven original members.
questions.context: S Club (English pop group): S Club, formerly known as S Club 7, are a British pop group formed in 1998 by Simon Fuller. The original members were Tina Barrett, Paul Cattermole, Jon Lee, Bradley McIntosh, Jo O'Meara, Hannah Spearritt and Rachel Stevens.

questions.question: Which American actress played the leading role of Blair Waldorf on the hit teen drama series Gossip Girl?
questions.explanation: Leighton Meester portrayed Blair Waldorf on The CW series Gossip Girl throughout its run from 2007 to 2012.
questions.context: Leighton Meester (American actress (born 1986)): Leighton Marissa Meester is an American actress, singer, and model. She is known for her starring role as Blair Waldorf on The CW television series Gossip Girl (2007–2012). She has also appeared in films such as Killer Movie (2008), Country Strong (2010), The Roommate (2011), Monte Carlo (2011), The Oranges (2011), The Judge (2014), The Weekend Away (2022), and EXmas (2023). She portrayed Angie D'Amato on the ABC sitcom Single Parents (2018–2020).

questions.question: Which cryptocurrency entrepreneur launched the FTX exchange before being convicted of fraud?
questions.explanation: Sam Bankman-Fried established the FTX cryptocurrency exchange and was once listed among the wealthiest Americans before his conviction.
questions.context: Sam Bankman-Fried (American entrepreneur (born 1992)): Samuel Benjamin Bankman-Fried, commonly known as SBF, is an American entrepreneur convicted of fraud. Bankman-Fried founded the FTX cryptocurrency exchange and was celebrated as a "poster boy" for crypto, with FTX having a global reach with more than 130 international affiliates. At the peak of his net worth, he was ranked the 41st-richest American in the Forbes 400.
